title: I ported MW2 into DOOM, using Opus 5.5
author: Few-Hunt-2424
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1x7l5yi/video/0jgumf6qxuvh1/player

I'm working on a project that ports MW2 into DOOM. I call it IW4DOOM.



It takes the guns from your copy of Modern Warfare 2 and puts them into DOOM. Recoil, spread, reload times, ADS and sprint all run on MW2's weapon logic, ported over to DOOM. The guns are rendered in 3D but compiled down to give them that DOOM look and feel.



It's inspired by all the game mashups people have been building lately, so I wanted to try my own spin on it.



What surprised me the most, is that once I had Claude write out all the spec files, on the initial plan I made, it basically one-shotted the whole integration without any bugs, or re-prompting, just clean execution.



It’s still very early and very much a work in progress, but I thought it would be cool to share it now while I keep working on it, making it more refined and actually fun to play.



Let me know what you all think, your feedback would be awesome!



[https://github.com/Andrew2142/IW4DOOM](https://github.com/Andrew2142/IW4DOOM)
